meta.title: Undergrowth theme gallery
meta.author: hello-nova-claw
meta.description: The plugin with the e2e test provider and the small demo blog (demo/undergrowth-demo-small.xml), read once, with a Garden page made from the plugin's pattern as the home page, its feed in the masonry layout, four posts given a format and no picture so the feed shows text cards beside image cards, and one demo post carrying the reader blocks, plus the themes listed in the writeFile step installed beside the default one, not activated. Used by playwright.gallery.config.js and bin/gallery-sheet.mjs; the theme list is read by bin/gallery-themes.cjs.

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/class-wp-upgrader.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/theme.php';

// Each theme is installed on its own, with WordPress's own installer, so
// one that wordpress.org no longer has, or a download that fails, leaves
// the others in place. The gallery lists a theme it cannot find as
// skipped. A theme the site already has, such as the default one, is left
// as it is.
$slugs = array_filter( array_map( 'trim', (array) file( WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/undergrowth-gallery-themes.txt' ) ) );

foreach ( $slugs as $slug ) {
	if ( wp_get_theme( $slug )->exists() ) {
		continue;
	}

	$upgrader = new Theme_Upgrader( new Automatic_Upgrader_Skin() );

	if ( true !== $upgrader->install( 'https://downloads.wordpress.org/theme/' . $slug . '.latest-stable.zip' ) ) {
		echo "Could not install the {$slug} theme.\n";
	}
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// The demo posts are read once they are all imported.
update_option( 'undergrowth_e2e_demo', 'importing' );

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;

// The post the most suggestions point at, so "Linked from" has the most
// to show once they are accepted. "More like this" fills for any post
// that has been read. Only a block-editor post is taken: the blocks are
// added to its content, and classic markup would lose its paragraphs
// beside them.
$rows    = $wpdb->get_results(
	$wpdb->prepare(
		'SELECT source_id, target_id FROM %i WHERE state = %s ORDER BY score DESC, source_id ASC',
		undergrowth_links_table(),
		'proposed'
	),
	ARRAY_A
);
$sources = array();

foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
	$sources[ (int) $row['target_id'] ][] = (int) $row['source_id'];
}

$chosen = 0;

foreach ( $sources as $target_id => $source_ids ) {
	$target = get_post( $target_id );

	if ( $target instanceof WP_Post && 'publish' === $target->post_status && has_blocks( $target ) && count( $source_ids ) > count( $sources[ $chosen ] ?? array() ) ) {
		$chosen = $target_id;
	}
}

if ( 0 === $chosen ) {
	throw new Exception( 'No demo post has suggestions pointing at it.' );
}

// Accept writes each link into the linking post as the author's click
// would, and refuses without an author, so this runs as the admin.
wp_set_current_user( 1 );

$accepted = 0;

foreach ( $sources[ $chosen ] as $source_id ) {
	if ( 'accepted' === undergrowth_accept_link( $source_id, $chosen ) ) {
		++$accepted;
	}
}

if ( 0 === $accepted ) {
	throw new Exception( 'No suggestion into the gallery post could be accepted.' );
}

// The spec finds the post by this slug.
$updated = wp_update_post(
	array(
		'ID'           => $chosen,
		'post_name'    => 'undergrowth-gallery',
		// Slashed, as wp_update_post() expects: a block attribute in the
		// demo post may hold an escaped character.
		'post_content' => wp_slash( "<!-- wp:undergrowth/growth-stage /-->\n\n" . get_post_field( 'post_content', $chosen, 'raw' ) . "\n\n<!-- wp:undergrowth/linked-from /-->\n\n<!-- wp:undergrowth/more-like-this {\"showExcerpt\":true} /-->" ),
	),
	true
);

if ( is_wp_error( $updated ) ) {
	throw new Exception( 'Could not add the reader blocks to the gallery post.' );
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// A garden mixes essays with notes, links and quotes, so four of the posts
// the feed shows first lose their picture and take a format. The Garden
// page then holds both cards, the image card and the text card, in every
// theme. This runs after the import and after the gallery post has its
// slug, so the posts exist and the gallery post keeps its picture, since
// the post shot shows it.
$post_ids = get_posts(
	array(
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'orderby'      => 'modified',
		'order'        => 'DESC',
		'numberposts'  => 12,
		'exclude'      => array( get_page_by_path( 'undergrowth-gallery', OBJECT, 'post' )->ID ),
		'fields'       => 'ids',
	)
);

foreach ( array( 1 => 'aside', 4 => 'link', 6 => 'quote', 9 => 'status' ) as $place => $format ) {
	if ( ! isset( $post_ids[ $place ] ) ) {
		throw new Exception( 'The demo blog has too few posts for the text cards.' );
	}

	delete_post_thumbnail( $post_ids[ $place ] );
	set_post_format( $post_ids[ $place ], $format );
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// A Garden page from the plugin's pattern, as the home page, so the reader
// blocks show on the front of the site with the demo blog, as the preview
// opens. The gallery is where the feed's masonry layout is judged in each
// theme, so the page holds the pattern's blocks with the feed switched to
// masonry, as an author who inserted the pattern and chose it would have.
// The pattern itself keeps the grid. A Posts page keeps the blog index
// reachable.
$pattern = WP_Block_Patterns_Registry::get_instance()->get_registered( 'undergrowth/garden-page' );
$content = is_array( $pattern ) ? str_replace( '<!-- wp:undergrowth/garden-feed {', '<!-- wp:undergrowth/garden-feed {"layout":"masonry",', $pattern['content'] ) : '';

if ( false === strpos( $content, '"layout":"masonry"' ) ) {
	throw new Exception( 'The Garden page pattern has no feed to switch to masonry.' );
}

$garden = wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'post_title'   => 'The Garden',
		'post_name'    => 'garden',
		// Slashed, as wp_insert_post() expects: the intro's placeholder is
		// a block attribute with escaped characters.
		'post_content' => wp_slash( $content ),
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
	),
	true
);
$posts = wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'   => 'page',
		'post_title'  => 'Posts',
		'post_name'   => 'posts',
		'post_status' => 'publish',
	),
	true
);

if ( is_wp_error( $garden ) || is_wp_error( $posts ) ) {
	throw new Exception( 'Could not make the Garden and Posts pages.' );
}

update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $garden );
update_option( 'page_for_posts', $posts );
